purpose: Provide a broad semantic page-region surface.
accessibility: Expose a stable accessible name and use the semantic element for the interaction.
Preserve visible focus, keyboard reachability, and disabled or pending state semantics.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: emphasis
api.description: Applies a bounded surface treatment without tinting the surrounding canvas.

api.name: tone
api.description: Selects the semantic colour used by a non-plain emphasis treatment.

api.name: colorway
api.description: Selects a categorical series for soft, expressive or solid emphasis. Solid uses a centrally paired foreground; tone retains semantic meaning.
